tier.//: Pre-registered 2026-11-05 by the product lead, before these sets were drawn. DEFAULT tier (blocking-eligible; its ACCEPT / shown is the headline default-tier accept rate) = the proposal's structured rule kind (lib.mjs ruleKind: conventions.yaml rule.type, rule.kind for wrapped_by, import vs other signal for avoids; never the summary text) is in default.rule_kinds AND its role has >= default.min_members members (PLAN: n >= 15 to allow blocking). SUGGESTION tier = every other shown proposal, including kinds listed in neither list and proposals without a structured rule. The not-wrong rate is reported over all shown proposals, both tiers.

default.//: call wrappers, decorators, base classes, required argument keys, layering (import avoidance), rendered components

suggestion.//: named by the product lead: generic calls, naming, absence (any/console/bare Error and other non-import avoids), preferred libraries, ordering, file/model/package rules. Not named in either list, so suggestion tier because the default tier is an allowlist: wrapped_by:jsx (rendered inside a wrapper), wrapped_by:try, control, directive, throws.
